subject: 400 Mystic Avenue Signage Special Permit
overview: The Medford Community Development Board endorsed an Approval Not Required plan for city-owned land and approved a sign special permit for Herb Chambers Toyota with modified pylon height limits. The board also continued two site plan review hearings to February 4, 2026, and discussed preparations for upcoming joint zoning hearings on Medford Square.

items.title: ANR Endorsement: City Hall Mall and Clippership Drive (AA-2025-5)
items.summary: The board endorsed an Approval Not Required plan subdividing city-owned land adjacent to City Hall to facilitate future mixed-use redevelopment.

items.title: Public Hearing Continuation: 255-257 Main Street Site Plan Review
items.summary: The board voted to continue the site plan review public hearing for 255-257 Main Street to February 4, 2026, to allow time for revised plans.

items.title: Public Hearing Continuation: 360 Salem Street (SPR-2025-4)
items.summary: The board voted to continue the public hearing for 360 Salem Street to February 4, 2026, pending a determination on high-frequency transit eligibility from the building commissioner.

items.title: Special Permit Hearing: 400 Mystic Avenue Signage (SP-2025-5)
items.summary: The board approved a special permit for wall and pylon signage at 400 Mystic Avenue for Herb Chambers Toyota, condition soundly capped on pylon heights at 30 feet for the primary sign and 19 feet for the pre-owned sign.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The board voted to approve the meeting minutes from October 15, 2025.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Board Procedures
items.summary: Staff and board members reviewed procedures for an upcoming joint hearing on Medford Square zoning with the City Council and discussed internal proposals to streamline the site plan review process.
